text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—You weren't on the grounds or in the 
classrooms, nor did you submit overnight 
stay slips to the dorm leader. 
When a situation like that happens, it 
makes us worried.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, Shinko Windy, Haru Urara, 
Samson Big. Why did you break curfew?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... W-We were doing a stakeout... 
B-But no one showed up... and while 
waiting, curfew kinda just passed...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I am deeply sorry, sir! 
This incident was caused by a lack of 
oversight on my part as the investigation 
leader!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I had requested their assistance with the 
archives storage room investigation. 
They broke curfew solely because they 
became overly dedicated to that task.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I should have anticipated this, yet I 
failed to provide the necessary 
warnings—the responsibility lies entirely 
with me! 
I ask that you discipline me, not them, 
sir!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey!? What're you—?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Very well... We will handle this matter 
taking Fenomeno's supervisory 
responsibility into account. 
Your punishment will be communicated at a 
later date.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you for your 
consideration, sir. 
If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone. 
I have been relieved of the archive 
storage room investigation assignment.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Another member of the Morals Committee 
will likely take over. 
Therefore, the mission I requested of you 
ends here.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Are you really... getting punished, 
Captain...? 
Just because we broke curfew...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is not your fault. 
Just as I told the teacher, this was my 
failure as an officer.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Please, do not look so downcast. 
You were only trying to improve the 
academy in your own way, were you not?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You thought for yourselves and took the 
initiative to improve the current 
situation! 
I truly admire that about you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hold your heads high! What you tried to do 
was wonderful! 
All I ask is that you take care not to 
repeat this mistake in the future.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
With that... thank you very much for your 
cooperation in this investigation! 
I express my heartfelt gratitude, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Captain...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...You didn't even break any rules... What 
an idiot...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The Captain acknowledged us so much, 
but... 
Far from being useful, we just...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I don't want things to end like this. 
Though if we act recklessly, we might just 
cause more trouble for the Captain—

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's at least clean up the 
storage room! 
We moved a bunch of stuff around during 
the investigation, remember?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do it! 
If it'll help the Cap'n, count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
They handed over the storage room key 
without any fuss! 
They even praised us for taking the 
initiative to clean up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If we do tons and to~ns of good deeds, 
maybe the Cap'n will come back, right? 
Let's do our best cleaning so that 
happens!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We should put those sticking-out papers 
back into that box too. 
Though... even on a step stool, I might 
not reach the top shelf box.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait right there, Biko. 
Windy-chan will climb up and grab it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, can't reach... Just a bit... 
wha—whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's falling?! —Windy-senpai, hold 
on tight! 
Ngh! Gggghhhhh~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Th-The shelf almost fell over...!  
If Biko hadn't supported it, I would've 
dropped!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Climbing bookshelves is dangerous, so we 
shouldn't do that again. 
Ah...—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
STOOOOOP! Climbing is dangerous! Excessive 
jumping and hazardous sprinting indoors 
are strictly prohibited!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I get it now. The reason the Captain 
yelled at us like that... 
Was because she was just so worried about 
us...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Captain...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there really nothing left we can 
do? 
Nothing at all for our Captain?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She said she needed *me*, not anyone else! 
I want to properly live up to her 
feelings!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then we continue the investigation, 
nodda!! 
That's the only way! That's why this 
investigation squad was formed in the 
first place, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-But, if we cause trouble for the Captain 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's fine as long as we don't get caught, 
nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even if we do get caught, we just take 
responsibility ourselves! Getting yelled 
at is fine, nodda! 
Or are you scared of getting yelled at!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan isn't scared! Getting yelled at 
is no big deal, nodda! 
'Cause after all, I'm bad to the bone!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Me neither! Getting yelled at doesn't 
scare me at all! 
Let's keep investigating! We're gonna 
solve this archive room issue!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I agree! I want to see this through 
to the very end, too! 
So, I guess we need to have a talk with 
those intruders!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Now, about how to call them out... Ah! 
Maybe we can use Urara-chan's graffiti! 
You got a reply, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! When I wrote a reply, they wrote 
back! 
They said, "Urara, as in Haru Urara?"!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you reply and ask them to meet 
up so we can talk! 
Other intruders will be able to see it 
there, too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, write a reply! 
Archive Room Investigation Squad, resume 
the investigation, nodda!!
